items.en: Iran unveils Arash-3 strike drone with payload of up to 150 kg; predecessor Arash-2 reportedly linked to Russia
items.nl: Iran onthult Arash-3-aanvalsdrone met lading tot 150 kg; voorganger Arash-2 zou naar Rusland zijn gegaan
items.sEn: Militarnyi reports that the commander-in-chief of the Iranian Army, Amir Hatami, has presented a new strike drone, the Arash-3, in a report by Rasadkadeh TV.
